from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib,re
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_official_cause_explanations_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
proto=readj(base/'protocol.json');raw=readj(base/'实际三项官方定位查询原结果.json')['raw_result']
targets=[{'economic_period':'2020M10','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896423.html','expected_clock':'2020/11/27 09:30','required_fragments':['1—10月份','50124.2亿元','增长0.7%']},{'economic_period':'2021M07','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202302/t20230202_1896530.html','expected_clock':'2021/08/27 09:30','required_fragments':['2021年7月份','增长57.3%','两年平均增长20.2%']},{'economic_period':'2024M04','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202405/t20240527_1954144.html','expected_clock':'2024/05/27 09:30','required_fragments':['1—4月份','增长4.3%','增长2.6%']}]
assert [x['economic_period'] for x in targets]==proto['targets_original_periods']
source_dir=base/'sources';source_dir.mkdir()
for t in targets:
 assert t['url'] in raw and not (source_dir/(t['economic_period']+'.html')).exists()
receipts={}
for t in targets:
 receipts[t['economic_period']]={'economic_period':t['economic_period'],'url':t['url'],'method':'GET','attempt':1,'authentication':0,'retry':False,'started_at':now(),'status':'STARTED_FIRST_AND_ONLY_GET'}
rp=base/'三个真实当期原解读首次GET回执.json';assert not rp.exists()
rp.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'requests':list(receipts.values())},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
def get(t):
 rec=receipts[t['economic_period']].copy()
 try:
  response=requests.get(t['url'],timeout=(12,30),allow_redirects=True)
  rec.update({'completed_at':now(),'status_code':response.status_code,'final_url':response.url,'redirect_urls':[z.url for z in response.history]})
  response.raise_for_status();p=source_dir/(t['economic_period']+'.html');p.write_bytes(response.content)
  response.encoding=response.apparent_encoding or 'utf-8';soup=BeautifulSoup(response.text,'html.parser')
  all_text=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True);article=soup.select_one('.TRS_Editor') or soup.select_one('.content') or soup.body
  text=article.get_text('\n',strip=True) if article else ''
  compact=re.sub(r'\s+','',text)
  clock_found=t['expected_clock'] in re.sub(r'\s+',' ',all_text)
  required={s:s in compact for s in t['required_fragments']}
  parsed={'economic_period':t['economic_period'],'url':t['url'],'source':p.as_posix(),'source_sha256':sha(p),'headings':[z.get_text(' ',strip=True) for z in soup.find_all(['h1','h2'])],'own_expected_clock':t['expected_clock'],'own_clock_found':clock_found,'original_body_required_fragments':required,'own_original_interpretation_source_qualified':bool(clock_found and all(required.values())),'article_text':text,'compact_article_text':compact,'all_visible_text':all_text,'actual_causal_stock_effect':'UNKNOWN','new_financial_fits':0}
  (source_dir/(t['economic_period']+'_原全文与自身公开钟.json')).write_text(json.dumps(parsed,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
  (source_dir/(t['economic_period']+'_原全文.txt')).write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
  rec.update({'status':'GET_COMPLETED_FULL_PRIMARY_INTERPRETATION','source':p.as_posix(),'source_sha256':sha(p),'bytes':len(response.content),'source_qualified':parsed['own_original_interpretation_source_qualified']})
  return rec,parsed
 except Exception as exc:
  rec.update({'completed_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(exc).__name__,'error':str(exc)})
  return rec,None
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
 results=list(pool.map(get,targets))
rp.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'requests':[r for r,p in results],'actual_attempts':3,'retries':0,'authentication':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
for rec,p in results:
 print(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 if p:print(json.dumps({'economic_period':p['economic_period'],'clock_found':p['own_clock_found'],'required':p['original_body_required_fragments'],'article_text':p['article_text']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
